minor_artifacts_desc: Minor Artifacts ( £ ) represent obscure technology and half-forgotten lore recovered from archaic civilizations, only partially understood by our own science. They are more common than Relics, and can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.
d_collapsed_spire_desc: An immense residential spire has collapsed under its own weight in this region, blocking access. While it was still standing, this towering structure must have been among the tallest on the planet.
d_massive_crevice_desc: This region is divided by a vast crevice that cuts through what was once a dense urban zone. The ground here is extremely unstable, with frequent earthquakes and landslides.
d_shattered_solar_array_desc: The shattered remnants of some kind of colossal solar array. When it was still functional, it must have provided power to a significant portion of this planet.
d_flooded_reactor_pits_desc: These deep pits appear to have once housed the planet's main energy production facilities. Over the eons, rain and flooding have filled the pits with murky water.
d_crumbling_mining_tunnels_desc: A network of deep tunnels beneath the planet's surface seem to have been its primary source of minerals. Millennia of cave-ins and rockfalls have left only a fraction of the tunnels traversable.
d_ancient_reactor_pits_desc: These deep pits near the planet's equator once housed its primary energy generators. Much of the surprisingly sturdy infrastructure has survived, and new reactors can be slotted into it.
d_immense_solar_array_desc: This solar array is nearly the size of a small continent. Most of it has been smashed beyond repair, but the underlying power infrastructure has survived, making it a good site for energy production.
d_abandoned_mining_tunnels_desc: Many of the ruins on the planet's surface were built by minerals extracted from these tunnels. Although most have been mined to depletion, there are still several with rich yields.
d_central_spire_desc: This towering structure appears to have served as the administrative center of the planet. Its central location and mostly intact interior provides an unmatched opportunity to research the ruins of this world.
d_industrial_sector_desc: This entire region once served as the industrial heartland of the planet. The factories and refineries that operated here have long since stopped working, but vast amounts of scattered resources can still be found in the area.
d_relic_dense_ruins_desc: The study of the dense ruins that cover this Relic World are a boon to science, but their presence also limits the amount of livable space.
d_relic_metal_boneyard_desc: The hollowed-out metal skeletons of fallen infrastructure seem almost to groan as the wind whistles through them.
d_former_relic_world_desc: This ecumenopolis was once an abandoned Relic World. Most of the old ruins were repurposed or cleared away when the planet-wide city was rebuilt, but there are still many sites that are of scientific value.
job_assimilation_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
astral_threads_desc: £ Astral Threads are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding with one another. They can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.
job_disconnected_drone_desc: Severed from their collective consciousness, these drones are guided by little more than base instinct.
feral_insight_desc: We are studying the feeding and behavioral cycles of mega-organisms.
d_electrified_oceans_desc: A perpetual electrical current surges throughout the planet's vast ocean.
d_ghostly_canyon_desc: Ethereal apparitions are witnessed by those who visit this canyon.
d_sky_mountain_desc: A colossal mountain range hangs suspended in the thin air of the planet's upper atmosphere, exposing fresh ore deposits.
d_avian_reserve_desc: A secluded nature reserve built to house vulnerable species of avian fauna.
d_magnetic_storm_1_minerals_desc: A passing cosmic storm has magnetized an immense amount of previously unexploited mineral deposits, making it exceedingly easy for our mining operations to access these new resources.
d_magnetic_storm_2_alloys_desc: A passing cosmic storm that ravaged this planet has left a significant number of foundry equipment strangely charged. Even without fully understanding the mechanism, our alloy production has improved significantly.
d_magnetic_storm_3_mix_desc: Magnetized by the gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm, the majestic and floating landmasses can be maneuvered directly over existing industrial complexes.
d_electric_storm_1_engineering_desc: A passing cosmic storm of incredible fury has transformed a once-thriving settlement into lightning-struck ruins, transmuting our mundane building materials into rare and unusual compounds.
d_electric_storm_2_unity_desc: A passing cosmic storm has unleashed such concentrated devastation upon the planet that it has carved a scar visible from space.
d_electric_storm_3_physics_desc: A passing cosmic storm has wreaked havoc on the navigation systems of countless civilian ships, turning the hardest-hit areas into haunting graveyards of broken hulks and decimated machinery.
d_particle_storm_1_society_desc: The Cosmic Storm has rendered some of our suburbs into ruins, fit only for study of the remains.
d_particle_storm_2_unity_desc: The Cosmic Storm has left a tremendous crater on this world, a brutal reminder of cosmic indifference to our existence.
d_particle_storm_3_motes_desc: The Cosmic Storm has turned several vast planes into areas of high tectonic activity, coincidentally the increase in danger has also come with an increase in volatile motes.
d_solar_storm_1_energy_desc: The Cosmic Storm has torn a hole into the ozone layer of this planets atmosphere. While severely infringing on our quality of life, the quality of production has gone up.
d_solar_storm_2_districts_desc: The Cosmic Storm has bathed the highlands of this world with radiation, creating a sublime ground for our energy production.
d_solar_storm_3_output_desc: The Cosmic Storm has left entire desert aglow, a deadly view but with sufficient security measures it can turned into a financially viable tourist spot.
d_celestial_storm_1_mines_desc: The ravaging blasts of a passing cosmic storm have left behind a landscape of jagged and spiked crystals, creating a perilous yet potentially profitable terrain.
d_celestial_storm_2_society_desc: A passing cosmic storm has blasted away entire layers of sediment, unveiling traces of eons we have never before been able to study.
d_celestial_storm_3_crystal_desc: A passing cosmic storm swept over this world like a great wave. In its wake, it left behind an ethereal landscape of glittering, stardust dunes.
d_gravity_storm_1_districts_desc: The crushing gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm have compacted several areas previously deemed too unstable for construction, effectively granting us free real estate.
d_gravity_storm_2_unity_desc: A passing cosmic storm unleashed tremendous pressure on some of our more fragile monuments, reducing them to dust and debris - a humble reminder of the terrifying forces that await us out there.
d_gravity_storm_3_engineering_desc: A passing cosmic storm has transformed some of our mining complexes into broken shafts of hyper-compact material. While our attempts to reopen them have sparked new theories in engineering and drilling, they have made little progress in reclaiming the mines.
d_shroud_storm_1_society_desc: A passing cosmic storm has spread parasites among our livestock. Phasing between our reality and the Shroud, they have proven to be edible, healthy and surprisingly delicious.
d_shroud_storm_2_zro_desc: Transformed by a passing cosmic storm, this planet's most verdant biomes have become wavering fields of Zro. These are some of the purest deposits we have ever encountered.
d_shroud_storm_3_happy_desc: A passing cosmic storm has left us with a strange and wonderful gift. The largest body of water on this planet forms ripples that create patterns and symbols of obvious importance, capable of answering inquiries with surprising wisdom.
d_terraforming_blocker_desc: The results of a partially successful terraforming project have created areas of strange biological abominations.
job_fe_overseer_desc: The stalwart few have rejected lives of luxury in favor of public service. It is up to them to oversee and guide the remnants of their ancient civilization.
job_fe_guardian_bot_desc: These ancient machines maintain a ceaseless vigil over the expired remains of billions of cryogenically frozen sapients.
job_fe_hedonist_desc: A life of total opulence, where every possible material need or desire can be satisfied.
job_low_tech_researcher_desc: Our former masters ignored our gifts and downplayed our intelligence. Now, the keenest minds among us are free to follow their ambition.
job_low_tech_laborer_desc: As assets they were worked to the bone. With freedom has come renewed purpose, and a vigor that no slave could ever hope to match.
job_low_tech_technician_desc: Aboard their masters' vessels, indentured engineers were often assigned the lowliest and most dangerous jobs. This hardship only sharpened their skills.
job_low_tech_miner_desc: Stubborn, ill-mannered, indomitable; these former indentured miners are as solid as scrap metal.
job_low_tech_farmer_desc: The agri-worlds of our former masters were scenes of brutal oppression. Now, our homesteaders are free to enjoy the fruits of their labor.
job_low_tech_priest_desc: Our preachers remind us that freedom is a divine right; united in faith, we find our common strength.
job_low_tech_warrior_desc: Indentured soldiers were mainly used as cannon fodder; the fortunate few who survived have volunteered to protect our newfound freedom with their lives.
job_low_tech_bureaucrat_desc: Our former masters delegated much of their empire's day-to-day administration to indentured assets. The result was a class of highly trained logistics personnel.
job_low_tech_manager_desc: Our former masters delegated much of their empire's day-to-day administration to indentured assets. The result was a class of highly trained managers.
job_broken_shackles_scavenger_desc: Scavengers explore the ruins of the Crashed Slaver Ship for anything of value.
job_fotd_protectors_desc: So that the majority can rest peacefully and enjoy their lives of extravagance, these rough individuals stand ready in the night to visit violence on those who would do them harm.
d_landgrab_blocker_desc: Purchased by off-world investors, these lands are no longer accessible to the indigenous population.
d_landgrab_foreign_holdings_desc: These parcels of land have been acquired from the indigenous population, and are now managed from orbit.
d_mass_graves_desc: After a cataclysmic plague decimated the global population, all that remains is a silent expanse that stretches towards the horizon. An empty landscape, occupied by countless lost souls.
job_trophy_hunter_desc: If it bleeds, we can kill it.
job_animal_handler_desc: The best ecosystems are managed with minimal direct intervention for the benefit of all species.
job_beastfighter_desc: The greatest of the beastfighters attract hundreds of thousands in attendance. There is no greater source of entertainment for the masses.
job_drone_wrangler_desc: The proper preservation, study, and management of local fauna is vital to the success of our worlds.
job_hunter_drone_desc: If it bleeds, we can kill it.
job_symbiosis_integrator_desc: The best ecosystems are managed with minimal direct intervention for the benefit of all species.
job_treasure_gatherer_desc: Trained to appraise all manner of rare and valuable goods, they can extract the highest value from treasures found across the galaxy.
job_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_desc: Able to appraise all manner of rare and valuable goods, they can extract the highest possible utility from treasures found across the galaxy.
d_radioactive_ruins_desc: An ancient civilization was wiped out here by a powerful gamma-ray burst long ago. These ruins are all that remain.
job_curator_desc: Curation of artifacts from the past and from other species is a highly skilled task.
job_geologist_desc: An expert in the solid, liquid, and gaseous matters that make up celestial bodies.
job_wonder_curator_desc: A sense of style and artistry is required when displaying the visual wonders of the galaxy.
job_drone_geologist_desc: An expert in the solid, liquid, and gaseous matters that make up celestial bodies.
job_drone_wonder_curator_desc: Selects pieces for display based on an objective set of artistic parameters.
job_drone_historical_curator_desc: Categorizes and contextualizes the most extraordinary specimens in order to gain a greater understanding of important galactic events.
d_mothballed_facilities_desc: Districts and buildings finished to the latest colonial standard, but obviously left in disuse and partial disrepair for years.
entropy_crystals_desc: This jagged, shimmering matrix of raw energy is somehow stable, just enough to be transported as fuel or embedded into equipment.
advanced_logic_desc: Advanced Logic measures our understanding of the universe's deepest secrets.
d_consumer_goods_obsessional_directive_d: This towering spire of commodities is stockpiled on the planet for future use.
job_overlord_healthcare_desc: The healthcare of a population is in the hands of teams of doctors.
job_overlord_replicator_desc: Replicators produce new components to install into new Automated Personnel Units.
job_overlord_spawning_drone_desc: The process of growing new organics is a difficult one, but specialised spawning drones enable growth.
job_organic_exhibit_desc: The uplifted organics enhance our drones' life-creation subroutines, infusing new perspectives and lessons into future projects.
d_mountain_range_desc: A vast range of tall and impassable mountains stretches across this region.
d_active_volcano_desc: There is an active volcano in this region, spewing forth lava and volcanic gases.
d_dangerous_wildlife_blocker_desc: The wildlife in this region is particularly lethal, with many dangerous predators and poisonous plants.
d_dense_jungle_desc: This entire region is completely overgrown with thick, impassable jungle.
d_quicksand_basin_desc: A vast body of quicksand covers this region, making construction impossible.
d_noxious_swamp_desc: Treacherous swamplands and bogs surrounded by putrid gases.
d_massive_glacier_desc: An immense body of dense ice covers this region.
d_toxic_kelp_desc: A thick forest of kelp that is toxic to most forms of life covers the ocean in this region.
d_deep_sinkhole_desc: A colossal sinkhole covers most of this region.
d_city_ruins_desc: Once a great city, now just a metal boneyard stretching as far as the eye can see.
d_wandering_forests_desc: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.
d_sinkhole_subterraneans_desc: A large hole in the ground that leads into the extensive cave network stretching beneath the surface of this world.
d_crater_desc: Something collided with the surface of this world at some point, creating this massive impact crater.
d_bomb_crater_desc: This massive crater was created by the detonation of a particularly devastating hydrogen bomb.
d_radioactive_wasteland_desc: Few organisms can survive in this desolate, irradiated wasteland.
d_failing_infrastructure_desc: This region is covered by ruined industrial complexes and toxic soil; detritus from a past age of progress.
d_decrepit_dwellings_desc: This region is covered by vast shanty towns and slums filled with the poor and the outcast.
d_titanic_life_blocker_desc: Numerous Titanic aliens make this area their home, it would be wise to avoid it.
d_tomb_world_ruins_desc: A scattered population of scavengers are eking out a desperate existence in the ruins of this once major city.
d_tomb_world_wasteland_desc: A region that was the target of numerous nuclear warheads. Though the radiation in this area has gone down since the initial impact, it is still unfit for habitation barring a major clean-up effort.
d_machine_empire_ruins_desc: The crumbling remains of what must once have been a major population center on the planet. No traces of its past inhabitants remain.
d_exterminators_ruins_desc: The charred and irradiated ruins of what was once a major organic population center. Those buildings that still remain standing contain nothing but ashes now.
d_assimilators_ruins_desc: This once major settlement is now a crumbling ruin, occupied only by the decaying bodies of those organics that chose self-termination rather than be assimilated.
d_former_battlefield_desc: Tens of thousands of burnt war machines and the twisted skeletal remains of organic soldiers litter the ground at this former battlefield. Residual pockets of radiation interferes with most electronics.
d_strip_mine_desc: This area was heavily strip mined in the past, by older and more primitive machine models that unfortunately were not programmed to take future development of the region into account.
d_unsupervised_settlement_desc: A pocket of organic society on this world that still exists outside of machine supervision. Violence, disease and starvation run rampant inside the settlement's walls, whose inhabitants have regressed technologically by several centuries.
d_hibernating_lithoids_desc: Incredibly rich outcroppings of minerals that seem to be comprised of petrified lithoids.
purge_labor_camps_tooltip: Affected Pops are worked to death and can be used to produce £ Food (or equivalent) until their eventual demise.
purge_processing_tooltip: Affected Pops are processed into [Root.GetPurgeProcessingResource] availability until death.
purge_matrix_tooltip: Affected Pops' physiologies are prepared for integration with the energy grid, where the chemical processes that sustain them are redirected to enrich our energy stores. The process is fatal, but death comes slowly.

£ Biomass is the raw organic potential generated by biological activity across the worlds of ['concept_owned_systems'].

volatile_motes_desc: These preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.
exotic_gases_desc: Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.
rare_crystals_desc: These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.
alloys_desc:
£ Alloys are advanced resources with significant military applications.

Among other things, they are used to construct ['concept_civilian_ships'], ['concept_military_ships'], ['concept_starbases'], and ['concept_megastructures'].

sr_zro_desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.
sr_living_metal_desc: This inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.
sr_dark_matter_desc: This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy several natural laws. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.
nanites_desc: Simple but powerful nanoactuators, allowing for complex manipulations and experiments of mesoscopic scales.
d_lithoid_devastation_desc: A lithoid devouring swarm has despoiled this region. With great effort it may be possible to undo the damage.
job_slave_unemployment_desc: These slaves are currently not assigned to any task.
job_livestock_lithoid_desc: They have but one purpose: to become feed for their betters.
job_livestock_zoo_animal_lithoid_desc: These xenos are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_livestock_zoo_beast_lithoid_desc: These xenos are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_purge_lithoid_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_purge_robot_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_assimilation_food_photo_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_assimilation_mineral_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_assimilation_mineral_photo_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_assimilation_void_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_hunted_pre_sapient_lithoid_desc: Pre-sapients have only a rudimentary intelligence, and are incapable of most work.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_lithoid_desc: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_xeno_zoo_beast_lithoid_desc: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_hunter_gatherer_lithoid_desc: These semi-nomadic explorers survive by foraging and hunting. There is evidence of early tool use.
job_overlord_spawning_drone_lithoid_desc: The process of growing new organics is a difficult one, but specialised spawning drones enable growth.
job_civilian_desc: The segment of our population not currently engaged in employment, education or training. Will travel for work.
job_mining_drone_desc: Drill enhancements and improved limb tensile strength allow mining drones to efficiently move large amounts of raw material.
job_warrior_drone_desc: Warrior drones are equipped with strategic and tactical upgrades, allowing them to control large amounts of drones over a vast area for use in battle.
job_crystal_mining_drone_desc: Drill enhancements and improved limb tensile strength allow dilithium mining drones to efficiently move large amounts of raw dilithium.
job_agri_drone_desc: Temperature sensors and nutrient injectors allow Agri Drones to ensure drones are kept in optimum nutrition balance.
job_technician_drone_desc: Energy monitoring and flow processing sensors are part of the Technician Drones specialised equipment.
job_replicator_desc: Replicators produce new components to install into new Automated Personnel Units.
job_coordinator_desc: Specially designated coordinators ensure optimal Automated Personnel Unit dispersal.
job_evaluator_desc: Signals to and from the Drones must be amplified, analyzed and cleaned of deviancy.
job_maintenance_drone_desc: The machinery, systems and infrastructure that serve our needs must be constantly maintained. As must other drones.
job_calculator_desc: The rapid calculation of the most optimum solutions to a problem are achieved via calculation drones.
job_fabricator_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these fabricators to work within the construction facilities.
job_patrol_drone_desc: Designed for security and cohesion, patrols drones ensure errant behaviour is quickly corrected.
job_colonist_desc: The creation of a new colony is hard work, with workers required to undertake many roles simultaneously.
job_miner_desc: Drills and tunnels still require trained miners in order to extract material.
job_crystal_miner_desc: Mining the raw Dilithium from the surface of a world is a hazardous job.
job_farmer_desc: A farmer is one who is engaged in agriculture, raising living organisms for food or raw materials.
job_technician_desc: Technicians ensure that complex machinery can continue to run.
job_clerk_desc: The administration of large sections of a planets workforce requires clerks to ensure things go where they are meant to.
job_preacher_desc: Monks follow their teachings and often dedicate their lives to the cause.
job_warden_desc: Wardens ensure laws and justice are meted out accurately.
job_foundry_desc: Workers manufacture complex goods via operation of heavy machinery.
job_enforcer_desc: Police Officers are employed by the government to enforce the law.
job_slave_overseer_desc: These relatively privileged slaves keep their less fortunate brethren in line.
job_telepath_desc: Telepathic members of the police force can be used to detect the intent to commit crimes before they even occur.
job_soldier_desc: A soldier is one who fights as part of an army. A soldier can be a conscripted or voluntarily-enlisted person, a non-commissioned officer, or an officer.
job_artisan_desc: Artisans are skilled workers, capable of producing high-quality goods.
job_entertainer_desc: An entertainer is someone who provides entertainment in many different forms, from comedy to acting to dance.
job_healthcare_desc: The healthcare of a population is in the hands of teams of doctors.
job_culture_worker_desc: An artist is a person engaged in an activity related to creating art, practicing the arts, or demonstrating an art.
job_head_researcher_desc: Within certain societies, the heads of research often control a large amount of political and military power.
job_researcher_desc: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.
job_engineer_desc: The maintenance of vast amounts of complex machinery can only be achieved by trained engineers.
job_priest_desc: A priest is a religious leader authorised to perform the sacred rituals of a religion, especially as a mediatory agent between a being and one or more deities.
job_chemist_desc: The delicate balance of the active ingredients in Ketracel White requires trained chemists.
job_manager_desc: A manager is the being responsible for administering a large staff.
job_politician_desc: The government of an entire planet is a daunting task that requires dedicated and highly trained individuals.
job_noble_desc: Those of the royal bloodlines are often granted privileges but are charged with leading their subjects fairly.
job_merchant_desc: The richest merchants often have a political influence far exceeding their wealth.
job_executive_desc: Executives control vast amounts of influence within this organisation.
job_livestock_desc: They have but one purpose: to become feed for their betters.
job_simple_drone_unemployment_desc: These Simple Drones are currently not assigned to any task.
job_complex_drone_unemployment_desc: These Complex Drones are currently not assigned to any task.
job_worker_unemployment_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.
job_specialist_unemployment_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.
job_ruler_unemployment_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.
job_purge_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_crisis_purge_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_organic_battery_desc: Their organic energy will be absorbed, until they expire.
job_bio_trophy_desc: Their only job is to be themselves.
job_bio_trophy_unemployment_desc: These Bio-Trophies are neglected and without our care, exposing them to the cruelty of the galaxy. Their existence is our failure.
job_slave_toiler_desc: Toilers perform the grueling menial labor required to keep crude infrastructure of the Thrall-World running.
job_servant_desc: Servants perform various menial domestic tasks and household work for their masters.
job_criminal_desc: These criminals live outside the bounds of legal society, some by choice and some by circumstance.
job_deviant_drone_desc: These deviants no longer obey the Hive Mind.
job_corrupt_drone_desc: These drones have been corrupted and no longer obey the directives of the core intelligence.
job_hunter_gatherer_desc: These semi-nomadic explorers survive by foraging and hunting. There is evidence of early tool use.
job_peasant_desc: The peasants toil endlessly in the fields, so that those perceived as their betters might prosper.
job_primitive_warrior_desc: Members of a combative warrior class. These fighters rely on bladed weapons, spears or various blunt instruments to see them through combat.
job_primitive_noble_desc: The landed nobility rule from their stone castles and keeps.
job_primitive_researcher_desc: The learned of this society, often relying on oral tradition to pass knowledge between generations.
job_primitive_priest_desc: Spiritual leaders and preachers who conduct religious ceremonies and oversee all matters concerning faith.
job_primitive_laborer_desc: These early industrial manufacturers toil away in factories, which can now be operated day and night thanks to recent advances in electricity.
job_primitive_miner_desc: Dangerous and sometimes lethal work in the dark bowels of the planet.
job_primitive_technician_desc: These technicians shuffle coal or maintain primitive nuclear generators.
job_primitive_farmer_desc: These farmers work the land, typically with the help of primitive but effective farming equipment.
job_primitive_researcher_2_desc: Researchers employing scientific methodology to advance the rapidly expanding knowledge base of their civilization.
job_primitive_priest_2_desc: Religious leaders who occupy various priestly offices.
job_primitive_entertainer_desc: Celebrities and media personalities that provide entertainment and distraction from day-to-day life.
job_primitive_warrior_2_desc: Professional soldiers, typically armed with early projectile weapons powered by exothermic combustion.
job_primitive_bureaucrat_desc: Many early industrialist and post-industrialist societies are governed by an ever-expanding class of civil servants.
job_hive_sustenance_drone_desc: The difference between a successful hivemind and a starved one comes down to how successful their resource procurement is.
job_hive_basic_agri_drone_desc: Simple and unspecialized drones work the fields, their consciousness aware that food can be grown, but the task has yet to be optimized.
job_primitive_hive_warrior_desc: Having yet to fully come to grips with genetic specialization, these drones are grown bulkier to protect their hive. They have yet to evolve any specialized weapon appendages.
job_primitive_hive_synapse_drone_desc: The budding Overmind formed between the local drones has found a need to extend their consciousness further. These more cerebral Synapse Drones mainly facilitate this.
job_primitive_hive_factory_drone_desc: Drones that are more or less part of the very factory they work in. These specialized laborers assemble everything from weapons to vehicles at an astounding rate.
job_primitive_hive_miner_desc: Sacrificing safety for success, these drones delve deep beneath the earth to feed the ever-hungry engine that is society.
job_primitive_hive_technician_desc: Operating dirty energy generators is not a job any living being can do forever. Still, these drones are enhanced with superior lungs as well as inherent radioactive resistance, so they last longer than most.
job_primitive_hive_farmer_desc: Food production overseen by a continent spanning hive-mind is a marvel of logistics and agronomy, every section of the designated agricultural area is used to its fullest.
job_primitive_hive_warrior_2_desc: Specialized for war, these hulking drones have multiple specialized appendages perfected for crushing their own species.
job_pre_sapient_desc: Pre-sapients have only a rudimentary intelligence, and are incapable of most work.
job_hunted_pre_sapient_desc: Pre-sapients have only a rudimentary intelligence, and are incapable of most work.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_desc: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_xeno_zoo_beast_desc: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_livestock_zoo_animal_desc: These xenos are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_livestock_zoo_beast_desc: These xenos are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_odd_factory_worker_desc: These workers labor in the ancient and mysterious factory of unknown origin. What could go wrong?
d_arid_highlands_desc: An elevated, dry ecoregion bearing sparse vegetation of desert grasses and scrubs.
d_hot_springs_desc: Groundwater heated by geothermal processes steams from the surface of these springs.
d_searing_desert_desc: With little precipitation, extreme temperatures and limited vegetation, these sandy deserts are hostile to most forms of life.
d_geothermal_vent_desc: A large geothermal vent allows for the harvesting of geothermal energy stored in the planets crust.
d_underwater_vent_desc: Metalliferous sediments react with superheated water in the planet's crust, venting chemicals along the seabed where tectonic plates diverge.
d_rushing_waterfalls_desc: Picturesque vistas formed when rivers flow over the cliff sides of steep mountainsides.
d_frozen_gas_lake_desc: Formed under immense pressure in a bygone age, deep-freeze temperatures have kept the gases dissolved in these rimey lakes in a solid state.
d_numas_breath_desc: This stable vent reaching into the planet's crust was created by The Numistic Order.
d_veiny_cliffs_desc: Bands of valuable mineral ores run like veins through these exposed cliff faces.
d_ore_rich_caverns_desc: These deep caverns are rife with metallic and mineral ore deposits.
d_mineral_fields_desc: Geological upheaval exposed these useful minerals to the planet's surface long ago.
d_rich_mountain_desc: These mountainsides glint with rich ore resources and precious stones.
d_prosperous_mesa_desc: This flat-topped hill has steep sides lined with useful resources.
d_submerged_ore_veins_desc: Useful ore deposits line parts of the ocean floor, providing opportunities for deep-sea mining.
d_bountiful_plains_desc: Fertile soils and tall grasses cover these sweeping plains, providing rich potential for farmlands.
d_nutritious_mudland_desc: A watery slurry of clay, silt, and loam stretches across the horizon, where low vegetation flourishes.
d_green_hills_desc: Rolling hills covered in greenery and fertile soils.
d_forgiving_tundra_desc: Sedges, shrubs and lichens cover this high-latitude biome, where the subsoil permafrost is nevertheless covered in more fertile sediment.
d_rugged_woods_desc: Cold, rocky woods with herbaceous understories.
d_boggy_fens_desc: These low-lying wetlands provide a wealth of plant nutrients.
d_lush_jungle_desc: With a dense canopy and nigh-impenetrable vegetation density, these jungles are poor in soil quality, but rich in plant life and fruit-bearing trees.
d_lichen_fields_desc: Dewy moss, lichens and fungi form a plush carpet that stretches across these rocky lands.
d_fungal_caves_desc: These extensive cave networks are covered in many species of edible fungi, which require neither sunlight nor fertile soil to flourish.
d_fungal_forest_desc: In lieu of trees, towering mushrooms dominate these fecund forests, the enormous caps of fungal giants blotting out sunlight to create the perfect environment for a rich variety of smaller specimens.
d_fertile_lands_desc: This vast stretch of open plains provides ideal farmland.
d_marvelous_oasis_desc: A shimmering jewel of water and greenery in a barren wasteland.
d_great_river_desc: A slow-flowing river of enormous volume provides water and vegetation for a rich abundance of life.
d_black_soil_desc: Black soil is very fertile and can produce high agricultural yields with its high moisture storage capacity.
d_teeming_reef_desc: A vibrant ecosystem brimming with corals, fish, mollusks, mammals, invertebrates, and all kinds of edible marine life.
d_tropical_island_desc: From fruit-laden trees to plentiful fauna, the bounties of this paradisiacal island promise a rich harvest.
d_metal_boneyard_desc: The hollowed-out metal skeletons of fallen infrastructure seem almost to groan as the wind whistles through them.
d_organic_landfill_desc: Toxic biohazard waste rots and fumes in vast heaps under the sun.
d_alien_pets_deposit_desc: This pristine valley lies sheltered amongst the surrounding mountains, its fauna shielded from roving predators.
d_migrating_forests_desc: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.
d_migrating_forest_reserve_desc: This entire region has been set aside for the migrating forests that are native to this world. Here they can roam in peace, without causing damage to urban areas.
d_junk_wastes_desc: The wastes stretch as far as one can see, with occasional pieces of larger junk jutting up out of the ground.
d_junk_canals_desc: These narrow canals snake around the junk piles, and some of the adjacent soil is surprisingly fertile.
d_junk_hollows_desc: These hollows deep beneath the surface junk would serve well as isolated reactor chambers.
d_irradiated_valley_desc: A solar flare has washed this isolated valley with heavy radiation.
d_valley_of_zanaam_desc: This valley is home to a mysterious obelisk that is covered in letters from a dead alien language. It hums with power and those in its proximity suffer headaches.
d_abandoned_primitive_homesteads_desc: These abandoned homesteads were once inhabited by a society of reptiles. They still populate the planet, but have since lost all capacity for sapient though.
d_the_zone_desc: A thirteen-by-thirteen kilometer stretch of land on this planet is a ruin of unknown origin, littered with many bizarre and unique alien artifacts. Bafflingly, it also produces sensations of deep contentment in its visitors.
d_hyperfertile_valley_desc: The soil in this valley is extremely fertile, and it is covered in intense greenery.
d_ancient_mining_site_desc: The site of an ancient mining operation. Despite its age, much of the equipment can still be operated.
d_toy_factory_complex_desc: Complex machinery ceaselessly molds complex polymers into small items of varying shapes and inscrutable purpose.
d_mutant_landfill_desc: A putrid mass of dead mutated horrors. Their volatile organic matter has twisted together to form a structure of sorts.
d_ancient_bombardment_craters_desc: This world was subjected to intense orbital bombardment long ago. Parts of the surface are still pockmarked with impact craters.
d_ancient_battlefield_desc: The civilization that once inhabited this world was destroyed by an invading force from somewhere beyond their solar system. This ancient battlefield is littered with ancient debris from their desperate last stand.
d_irradiated_ruins_desc: Remnants from a massive nuclear war waged by the two global superpowers that once inhabited this world.
d_impact_crater_desc: A crater from a large meteor impact. Minerals from the meteor itself can still be found at the site.
d_odd_factory_desc: A well-crafted facility that produces high value resources, left on the planet by a different civilization.
d_ancient_particle_accelerator_desc: This old particle accelerator was built using a novel design, and the surviving terminals within the structure contain a massive amount of research data composed by what must have been a brilliant theoretical physicist.
d_underground_vault_desc: A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault's occupants turned on each other when their food ran out.
d_underground_vault_2_desc: A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault contains a huge machine park along with stores of mining equipment.
d_cryonic_clones_desc: Hundreds of alien clones were left sealed in cryostasis chambers when this Ring World was still a ruin. Now fully restored, the clones have been preserved in this monument.
d_flooded_mounds_desc: Thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds can be found far beneath the ocean on this world, the last remnants of an ancient species of sapient arthropoids.
d_processing_pens_desc: The fungoids native to this planet were genetically engineered to be docile... and delicious. In these vast processing pens, the fungoids are nourished and then harvested.
d_harvester_fields_desc: Vast fields of dense, edible vegetation where ancient solar-powered harvesters assist in gathering crops.
d_wetware_computer_desc: The oceans on this world are almost completely covered in a fine network of algae that appear to be a primitive wetware computer.
d_savage_wildlands_desc: The indigenous creatures who inhabit this region appear to operate as a single organism.
d_worm_mine_desc: Narrow shafts twist around spiraling mineral veins.
d_worm_farm_desc: The food crops lean into the wind, somehow.
d_underground_farm_desc: A network of vast caverns which contain numerous fungal farms, hunting areas, and lakes teeming with edible flora and fauna.
d_underground_mine_desc: Underground tunnels lead to a variety of mineral-rich ore veins inaccessible from the surface.
d_underground_generator_desc: Subterranean rivers and the geothermal energy from the molten core of the planet offer vast potential for energy generation.
d_underground_contact_zone_desc: An area where Subterranean dwellers and Surfacers can work together towards peace and prosperity.
d_underground_farm_blocked_desc: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.
d_underground_mine_blocked_desc: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.
d_underground_generator_blocked_desc: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.
d_underground_farm_dead_desc: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.
d_underground_mine_dead_desc: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.
d_underground_generator_dead_desc: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.
d_portal_research_zone_desc: A secure complex has been built around the Dimensional Portal to house research staff dedicated to probing its mysteries.
d_portal_research_zone_gestalt_desc: A secure complex has been built around the Dimensional Portal to house research staff dedicated to probing its mysteries.
d_ancient_one_desc: An ancient being, living deep beneath the waves, is the dominating life force on this planet.
d_fungoid_extermination_desc: This toxic goo is all that remains of the exterminated Fungoids.
d_ruined_arcology_desc: The Arcologies which cover this City-Planet lie in ruins. While the foundations are still solid, much of the decaying structure will need to be cleared before we can rebuild.
d_egg_cracking_desc: Seismological phenomena are causing the planet crust to crack, spewing out sulfuric gases and toxic slime.

menace_desc: Menace is a measure of our resonance with the calamitous energies of the Shroud.
d_progenitor_desc: The Progenitor's nest, where every single Offspring is born.
d_progenitor_empty_desc: The once-mighty Progenitor has been vanquished, which has left the swarm in disarray.
d_admirals_bickering_crashed_cargo_ship_: The cargo ship destroyed a housing district, but opened up an unexpected mineral vein.
d_technocracy_toxic_waste_blocker_desc: A toxic wasteland caused by research done on the structural integrity of the planet. Cold-hearted scientists may be interested in how it will affect those living on the planet.
d_technocracy_barren_lands_blocker_desc: Barren lands left by the original toxic waste on the planet, after a significant amount of the fauna and flora was destroyed.
d_technocracy_toxic_ocean_blocker_desc: A significant amount of the water on the planet has been affected by toxic waste on the planet, being incredibly destructive to nearby land and leaving it inhospitable to those who used to live there.
d_technocracy_molten_waste_blocker_desc: Molten lava emerged from the ground after a notable earthquake on the planet, causing untold damage to many of the colonies nearby.
d_spawning_complex_blocker_desc: A large hulking biomass, alive and pulsating as it is slowly producing new workers for the hive.
d_prospectorium_strip_mine_desc: An expertly built mining complex, making efficient use of the local resources.
d_nature_preserve_blocker_desc: A section of natural beauty decreed by the Overlord to never be tampered with.
job_overlord_propagandist_desc: Propagandists working for the local ministry are experts at infiltrating and defusing situations among the locals.
job_overlord_propagandist_drone_desc: Diplomatically equipped drones who are experts at defusing rebellious thoughts and ideas.
job_overlord_academic_desc: Academics who work with specialists from several empires, conducting particular experiments and research that can benefit them all.
job_overlord_academic_drone_desc: Specifically equipped drones who utilize resources from several empires to conduct unique experiments and research.
job_overlord_trader_desc: Traders who specialize in selling foreign goods at the local domestic market.
job_overlord_trader_drone_desc: A distribution drone which specializes in redistributing foreign goods among its peers for maximum efficiency.
job_aid_worker_desc: Aid workers bring foreign knowledge and goods to improve the lives of the local population, in ways often overlooked by the domestic government.
job_aid_worker_drone_desc: Aid workers bring foreign knowledge and goods to improve the lives of the local population, in ways often overlooked by the domestic government.
job_overlord_breeder_desc: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet. It's also a fairly well paid job.
job_overlord_breeder_drone_desc: Feeding the newborn drones is an important part of ensuring the young spawn can grow correctly, quickly, and effectively.
job_mind_thrall_desc: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.
job_mind_thrall_drone_desc: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_desc: It is a prestigious responsibility to keep the Offspring safe and comfortable, even if the role often involves merely gathering food for it.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_dron: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet.
job_overlord_metallurgist_desc: Workers manufacture complex goods via operation of heavy machinery.
job_overlord_foundry_drone_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these units to work within high temperature alloy construction.
job_overlord_fabricator_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these fabricators to work within the construction facilities.
job_overlord_catalytic_technician_desc: Highly trained workers are needed to turn raw organic matter into durable alloys necessary for advanced construction.
job_overlord_catalytic_drone_desc: Valuable organic compounds are processed into durable alloys for naval development and advanced construction by highly-specialized Catalytic Drones.
job_overlord_beholder_desc: Military overseers working with a larger network of command centers to calculate the best possible defense routes for their contractor.
job_overlord_beholder_drone_desc: Military drones working within a larger synaptic network to calculate the best possible means of defense.
job_overlord_necromancer_desc: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.
job_overlord_necromancer_drone_desc: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.
job_overlord_reassigner_desc: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.
job_overlord_reassigner_drone_desc: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.
job_overlord_recruiter_desc: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.
job_overlord_recruiter_drone_desc: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.
job_overlord_ranger_desc: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.
job_overlord_ranger_drone_desc: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.
job_overlord_arborist_desc: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.
job_overlord_arborist_drone_desc: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.
job_overlord_bio_trophy_desc: Worried that we might lack for anything or even be hurt, our Overlord has provided a lucky few with the opportunity to experience what they call "mandatory pampering."
job_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_desc: The drones our Overlord directed to this structure are told to "relax" and "enjoy themselves." The Overlord may not fully understand the nature of a drone, but at least the sensations are novel.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_desc: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, but our way forward is by accepting them. Only those who are willing will be asked to make the ultimate sacrifice.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_drone_desc: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, yet we are to be a part of them. A few of our drones have been designated to join what the Overlord calls 'a study of life', one which concludes with their willing sacrifice.
job_overlord_manager_desc: Middle managers that optimize the behavior of the local white-collar workers to synergize with the Overlord's long-term corporate trajectory.
job_purge_sacrifice_desc: The Eater craves more than conflict alone. The bodies of our enemies are fitting tribute.
purge_sacrifice_tooltip: Affected Pops are offered in sacrifice to the Eater of Worlds, which repays us in £ Zro and £ Unity.
d_exploited_deposit_blocker_desc: This area has been completely stripped of its natural resources, and is now reduced to a wasteland.
job_overlord_knight_desc: Trained for combat; well educated; virtuous. These knights represent the very best of our society, and they have dedicated their lives to the search for the Toxic God.
job_overlord_knight_drone_desc: Trained for combat; well educated; virtuous. These knights represent the very best of our society, and they have dedicated their lives to the search for the Toxic God.
job_overlord_bath_attendant_desc: Trained Attendants for the Mutagenic Spas. Their purpose in life is to ensure their clients' continued health through a variety of services, including intemperate detoxification and carefully curated genotype degeneration.
job_overlord_bath_attendant_hive_desc: Specialized Drones, grown for the sole purpose of overseeing the Permutation Process during the creation of new biological drones for the hive.
job_overlord_bath_attendant_machine_desc: Lubrication Terminals are specially programmed drones, overseeing the submerged production of new shells, carefully monitoring the lubricant conditions during the process.
d_tainted_snowcaps_desc: The last toxic remains of the once enormous mountains of poison that dominated this world.
d_poisonous_algae_desc: This noxious algae survived the initial cleansing of this world. While it is not aggressive enough to prevent colonization, it has proven highly adaptable... and quite simply a nuisance.
d_venomous_insects_desc: The lost broods of venomous vermin that we had hoped to extinguish during the early days of our terraforming effort.
d_unpleasant_atmosphere_desc: The disgusting taste and smell of the air are what remains of this planet's toxic past.
d_rotten_soil_desc: Even this rotten soil will be useful to us, once it has been refreshed and reinvigorated.
d_acamar_molnar_desc: One of the largest cities on Acamar, Molnar city is known for its many villages and is home to the Lornak clan.
d_admonition_site_desc: A site known only to those who swear loyalty to the mysterious Zhat Vash, its mere presence is enough to ward most from approaching.
d_altamid_ancient_mining_equipment_desc: This mining facility appears ancient, yet highly efficient. Numerous drone bays and unique adaptation pods beyond common understanding are here, allowing for extremely high mineral production.
d_andoria_eastern_archipelago_desc: Dormant volcanoes dot this archipelago, a remnant of a more seismically active time.
d_andoria_harbortown_desc: Harbortown is the oldest continuously settled city on Andor and the third most populous. The city is situated on the island of Cheshras, between the Moss and Frost rivers. Harbortown began as a collection of small fishing villages in the largest natural harbor on the satellite, eventually merging to form the modern city.
d_andoria_laikan_desc: Laikan, the capital city of Andoria, is located on the Zhevra continent in the more temperate latitudes of Andor. Temperatures during the summer months average a few degrees above zero.
d_andoria_lortan_desc: Lor'Tan is the largest city on the planet Andoria and serves as the center for the Andorian cultural, economic, and political life.
d_andoria_northern_wastes_desc: The hidden, underground Aenar compound has been located. Its discovery reunited the Aenar with the rest of the Andorian people.
d_andoria_unexplored_wastes_desc: The vast desolate northern wastes are inhospitable, even to the hardiest Andorians.
d_andoria_vezhdar_plain_desc: The Vezhdar Plain is a large, featureless geographical area on Andor.
d_andoria_wall_of_heroes_desc: The Wall of Heroes is a memorial on Andoria. When a member of the Andorian Imperial Guard dies offworld, it is customary that his companions take his blood back to Andoria.
d_andoria_weyzhiss_mountains_desc: The Weyzhiss Mountains are a vast mountain range located on Andoria. Avalanches and seismic activity are common here.
d_animal_arthropoids_desc: Simple humanoids with a loose tribal association, they are known to be strong and vicious.
d_animal_cetieel_desc: The Ceti eel is a burrowing desert animal native to the planet Ceti Alpha V, capable of surviving the extremes of its environment. Ceti eels incubate their larvae in the plates of their jointed carapace. Upon emergence, the eel larvae can enter the ear of a larger animal, where it wraps itself around the cerebral cortex. The effect causes the host extreme pain and renders them extremely susceptible to outside suggestion. Over time, as the larvae mature, the subject suffers from madness and eventual death.
d_animal_drayjin_desc: The Drayjin are large mammals native to the rogue planet Dakala. Drayjin are migratory and females can be very aggressive, especially when they are protecting a nest.
d_animal_dryworm_desc: The giant dry-worm is a creature native to the planet Antos IV. It is capable of generating and controlling energy without causing harm to itself.
d_animal_eden_fruit_desc: The plant life on Eden is unique as they all contain highly corrosive and poisonous acid.
d_animal_egg_alien_desc: Just put your face next to this egg.
d_animal_egg_bugs_desc: Come on you apes. You want to live forever?
d_animal_furfly_desc: A Talaxian Furfly is a huge, fly-like insect native to Talax that is covered in several spines and has a long tail.
d_animal_gergher_desc: Only used to scare Yaderan children, the tales of Gergher beasts are a reminder to fear the dark.
d_animal_goat_desc: Torothan goats are a type of animal native to the Torothan homeworld. These mammals have mottled, brown hair and four pink horns (two straight, two curved) on their foreheads.
d_animal_hengrauggi_desc: The Hengrauggi, or Hengra, is a predatory creature native to the ice planet Delta Vega. It has three sets of limbs: two used for running and a smaller hand-like set. It has hundreds of eyes and a protrusion which serves as a whip which they can use to grasp their prey.
d_animal_hookspider_desc: The Talarian hook spider is an arachnid with legs that are approximately half a metre long. Its mandibles and legs end in vicious hooks that can cause lacerations.
d_animal_humpback_desc: Hunted to extinction in the 21st century, the humpback whales have complex songs, comprising a full language.
d_animal_hypnoid_desc: The Rigellian hypnoid is a pink, six-legged reptile native to the Rigel system. They have the ability to create illusions in the mind of nearby observers.
d_animal_kaminar_fredalia_desc: The Fredalia is a vividly red flower native to the planet Kaminar. These plants have cultural and sentimental value to the Kelpiens, as they are often used for making fredalia tea and medicinal salves.
d_animal_lavafly_desc: The Lavafly is an insect native to the Talaxian moon of Rinax, where the largest, most vicious specimens can reach up to six centimetres in length.
d_animal_moonbeast_desc: Some Valtese describe the sound of the Valtese horns as like the braying of Targhee moonbeasts. The horns are said to soothe the nerves of Valtese men.
d_animal_mugato_desc: The Mugato is an ape-like carnivore that inhabits the subtropical savanna regions of the planet Neural. Mugatos are large, intimidating animals that could reach a height of two metres, with large horns atop their heads. Their teeth are serrated, sharp, and capable of injecting a strong venom, fatal to many species within hours.
d_animal_muktok_desc: The Muktok plant is a species of flowering plant native to the planet Betazed. Muktok plants live to be hundreds of years old and produce a pleasant scent with their flowers chiming lightly when shaken.
d_animal_neprimates_desc: Similar to Terran monkeys, the New Earth primates are small harmless creatures.
d_animal_redbat_desc: The Andorian redbat is a flying mammal native to the moon Andoria. It is considered edible by some, but generally not palatable to a majority of the populace.
d_animal_rhyl_desc: The Rhyl is a worm-like creature often kept by Ba'ku children as pets.
d_animal_sehlat_desc: Sehlats are giant, 'teddy bear'-like beasts, native to Vulcan. Sehlats have six-inch fangs and do not like to climb, preferring to remain on low ground.
d_animal_setleth_desc: The Set'leth is a Romulan creature very similar to the Vulcan Sehlat, which are giant, 'teddy bear'-like beasts.
d_animal_singing_flower_desc: The flowers on this planet naturally vibrate at the same resonance as the air, creating a beautiful singing sound wherever they are located.
d_animal_targs_desc: Targs are generally regarded as 'vicious and destructive' animals. Klingons keep domesticated targs as pets and livestock, and they hunt wild targs for sport.
d_animal_tube_grubs_desc: Tube grubs are a larva-like animal, eaten as a delicacy by the Ferengi. Tube grubs are usually eaten live, though they can also be minced or fried.
d_animal_turtles_desc: The Risan sea turtle is an aquatic amphibian indigenous to Risa, capable of camouflaging itself well against the golden sands.
d_animal_yridianyak_desc: The Yridian yak is a large mammal native to the Yridian homeworld capable of reaching a mass of around 300 kilograms.
d_ardana_stratos_desc: Stratos is the peaceful capital city of the planet Ardana. It is one of the finest examples in the galaxy of sustained anti-gravity levitation and magnificent anti-gravity engineering. Built in the 14th century by leaders who promised that all inhabitants would live there, Stratos is now home only to the Ardanan elite, whose wealth allows them to fill the city with art and culture.
d_asteroid_anomaly_desc: Strange crystals reside within this asteroid, emitting unusual signatures.
d_asteroid_cavern_desc: This asteroid has a vast cavern network.
d_asteroid_dilithium_caverns_desc: A very rare asteroid filled with rich dilithium veins, it must have been ejected from a planetoid many centuries ago.
d_asteroid_fissionable_desc: Filled with fissionable elements, this asteroid is a source of material for energy generation.
d_asteroid_gemstones_desc: Veins of rare gemstones permeate this asteroid.
d_asteroid_ice_field_desc: The field contains a large number of asteroids covered in ice.
d_asteroid_metallic_desc: Large sources of metals fill this asteroid.
d_asteroid_pocket_desc: Large, hollow pockets within this asteroid are easily sealed to provide an atmosphere.
d_asteroid_regolith_desc: Solid layers of rock make up this asteroid.
d_asteroid_volatile_desc: An asteroid made up of volatile deposits of biomatter, it is useful for the creation of foodstuffs.
d_asteroid_water_pockets_desc: Sealed under the surface of this asteroid are rich deposits of deuterium.
d_bajor_bhala_desc: Lost for twenty thousand years, the city of B'hala has been rediscovered after extensive excavations. The area is a prime site for a new city to be rebuilt.
d_bajor_carnivorous_desc: The rastipod is a vicious but clumsy animal, with many Bajorans believing the animal has two left legs. It does have unique sensory properties which aid in finding prey using it's clumsiness, which scientists have studied for many years.
d_bajor_fire_caves_desc: The Fire Caves on Bajor are believed to be a prison created by the Prophets to contain the Pah-wraiths after they attempted to seize the Celestial Temple.
d_bajor_jalanda_city_desc: The large city of Jalanda is also the site of the Jalanda Forum, a vast square renowned across the planet as a meeting point for artisans.
d_bajor_jumja_desc: The thick sap of the Jumja tree is harvestable and capable of being turned into great delicious treats.
d_bajor_kendra_valley_desc: The Kendra Valley is an area of Kendra Province on Bajor, famed for its fertile lands. Seismic activity ensures the land remains rich in minerals.
d_bajor_lostcity_desc: Prophecies of a lost city were discovered with the guiding hand of the Prophets. A great archaeological dig could be undertaken to reveal what is hidden.
d_bajor_makara_desc: The makara herbs found across the plains of Bajor have for centuries offered pain relief and medicinal purposes.
d_bajor_mount_kola_desc: Kola Mountain is in Bajor's Dahkur Province. Its vast cave systems have been used as storage during times of weal, and hardy defence during times of woe.
d_bajor_straits_of_bharaq_desc: The northernmost sea is one of the most treacherous and dangerous seas on Bajor. The waters teem with life, and the currents are so strong they are suitable for tidal power stations.
d_bajor_trilar_peninsula_desc: The Trilar Peninsula is a heavily irrigated area drawing water from the many flowing rivers in the area. Farming is common here on the irrigated lands, and many small settlements crisscross the lands.
d_bajoran_temple_desc: The discovery of the Orb of the Emissary has resulted in Bajorans flocking to the location to pay homage to the Emissary.
d_baku_village_desc: A simple settlement on the planet Ba'ku, where metaphasic radiation offers a rejuvenating effect on tissue.
d_benev_selec_sr_dilithium_orbit_deposit: Easily mined from orbiting rocks and asteroids, this area offers a source of Dilithium found on the planet Benev Selec.
d_betazed_jalara_jungles_desc: Humid temperatures and tamed wildlife permeate the Jalara Jungles, where Betazoids can use their latest telepathy to commune with nature.
d_betazed_janaran_falls_desc: The Janaran Falls are a series of waterfalls that are said to be extremely scenic.
d_betazed_lake_cataria_desc: Lake Cataria is a vast body of water far away from any settlement on the planet of Betazed.
d_betazed_loneel_mountains_desc: The Loneel Mountains are a range of dormant volcanoes on the planet Betazed. Ancient volcanic activity created a network of tunnels and caves throughout the mountains, which also contained high concentrations of sensor-blocking fistrium.
d_betazed_mount_traxanaxanos_desc: Mount Traxanaxanos is the largest mountain on Betazed and receives many visitors who attempt to climb it during the temperate seasons.
d_betazed_opal_shores_desc: Named after the colouration of the water due to the undersea flora, the Opal Shores offer unrivalled beaches and water activities.
d_betazed_rixx_desc: Rixx is the capital city of Betazed and is the home of the Sacred Chalice of Rixx.
d_betazed_valley_song_desc: The fertile Valley of Song is known as such for its vast array of noisy wildlife that chirps and chirrups across the entire valley, creating a natural song.
d_bio_hazard_desc: This land was devastated by an ancient weapon, leaving behind a horrific biohazard.
d_bio_hive_mustering_desc: When the physic call comes in to defend the Undine territory, the natural instinct to gather at the mustering areas is overwhelming.
d_bio_mass_lake_desc: An exceptionally large lake of biomass covering the surface, many Undine consider this the starting place of their species and so it has become a sacred space.
d_boliax_alnat_province_desc: Alnat Province was the location of an independent nation-state on Bolarus prior to the time that it was politically united, but it was led into ruin.
d_boliax_bolsetu_city_desc: The former capital of the continent, Bolsetu City is famous for the Bolian Academy of Applied Sciences and the Bolian Interstellar Research Institute.
d_boliax_cliffs_of_bole_desc: The great Cliffs of Bole rise above the clouds, unique amongst many planets.
d_boliax_rabor_archipelago_desc: The Rabor Archipelago is a collection of inhabitable islands with a beautiful climate.
d_boliax_rasnih_mountains_desc: The Rasnih mountains can be seen across most of the northern hemisphere.
d_boliax_rholdar_desc: Rholdar is a domed underwater settlement.
d_boliax_senden_funnel_desc: The Senden Funnel is a massive tidal disruption that occurs due to the confluence of three strong oceanic currents.
d_boreth_dark_heart_of_malor_desc: Deep within the jungles and forests, the Dark Heart of Malor is found. It is an ancient grove said to be the location of the great titan Malor.
d_boreth_feklhrs_trough_desc: Feklhr's Trough is named for the legend that said that he carved out the trough with his claws during the great battles of the past.
d_boreth_forest_of_grethor_desc: The Jungles of Gre'thor are aptly named, as they are filled with peril and death at every turn. There is nothing more dishonourable than being snuck up on and killed by a shrub.
d_boreth_grikshak_hordes_desc: Hordes of Grikshak make their homes here. They are capable of ripping apart most species with ease, and juveniles can reach the size of a small aircar.
d_boreth_lava_caves_desc: Kahless is said to one day return amongst the putrid fumes of the lava caves of Boreth, according to the Story of the Promise.
d_boreth_malors_bones_desc: The whitened rock structure in this area is said to be the bones of Malor.
d_boreth_plain_of_haros_desc: Historically, the Plain of HarOs was where combat occurred between rival Houses.
d_boreth_spires_desc: The highest peaks are where the great monastery of Boreth is historically located.
d_boreth_valley_qamchee_desc: Named after the historic Klingon warrior Qam-Chee, where it is said Qam-Chee and his warriors fought off a darkness sent by Malor.
d_boreth_vergh_plateau_desc: The Vergh Plateau offers unparalleled views over much of the jungles and forests.
d_breen_linnavhava_desc: The Linnavhava is the centuries old residence of the Domo of the Breen. Sprawling around the structure is a submerged city that can be seen from the shielded promontory.
d_breen_prime_city_desc: The glacial capital city of the Breen, from whence they first launched into space, lies atop a slow moving glacier. It's ever shifting ground is a constant reminder of the struggle that every Breen faces, and how they can overcome the problem if they work together.
d_bynus_mainframe_desc: The housing for the Central Computer, essential to Bynar civilisation, is stored within a bunker deep underground.
d_capital_city_desc: Filled with massive amounts of population, the capital city of this world is the central authority for all matters relating to the planet.
d_cardassia_andak_project_desc: The importation of rich soils and creation of irrigation systems have caused the Andak province to once again flourish in verdant greens and browns again. The ecological damage caused by climate change has been all but eradicated from this area.
d_cardassia_andak_wasteland_desc: Once a thriving ecosystem, the vast ecological changes that hit Cardassia have rendered this once flourishing region a desolate wasteland.
d_cardassia_cardassia_city_desc: Cardassia City is the capital city of Cardassia and the Cardassian Union. The city is divided into seven different sectors, with the Tarlak Sector containing most governmental administrative buildings.
d_cardassia_culat_desc: Culat is a large urban area on Cardassia. The University of Culat is located here, where the students learn many crafts. Due to the youthful nature of the students, it is also a hotbed of dissidents.
d_cardassia_helta_highlands_desc: The Helta Highlands were once a thriving ecosystem, but now are barren hills.
d_cardassia_lakarian_city_desc: At some point in the past, Lakarian served the purpose of centralising the planetary government in a more subtle and aesthetic manner until Cardassia City was created, which became a more appropriate seat of power for the empire. Many of the buildings dated back to the early stages of the Republic, with even a number of Hebitian ruins somehow surviving the almost complete eradication of that culture.
d_cardassia_mekar_wilderness_desc:
The Mekar Wilderness is an arid highland area on Cardassia. The climate is hot and the region is characterised by beautiful rock formations and an extensive network of subterranean caverns.

The area is almost completely devoid of artificial construction. Adjacent to the wilderness you can find the Bamarren Institute for State Intelligence, which used the wilderness tough environment to test their students' physical endurance.
d_cardassia_morfan_province_desc: Morfan Province is a popular area for vacations on Cardassia due mainly to the unique rainforest of the Ba'aten Peninsula, the only rainforest to survive the climatic change and drought that struck the rest of Cardassia.
d_cardassia_regnar_mountains_desc: The Regnar Mountains are a vast undulating set of arid mountains located on Cardassia. With a harsh climate and unique geographical chasms located throughout, the Regnars are often used by younger Cardassians to test their might.
d_cardassia_rogorin_province_desc: Rogarin Province is a mountainous region on the planet Cardassia that is rich in ore. The province was the home of the Brangwa species and early Cardassians who used Brangwa hide to record their poetry and cultural stories.
d_cardassia_valley_hebitians_desc: Formerly known as Gardat Valley, the Valley of the Hebitians is situated on the continent of Eheen. A group of Cardassian archaeologists recently uncovered a number of burial mounds in the valley which served as the tomb of various kinds, as well as leaders of the ancient First Hebitian civilization. Following this discovery, the valley was renamed in honor of their distant ancestors.
d_centauri_uni_desc: Located on the northernmost continent of the planet, Delthara University Complex is the main educational facility on Al Rijil.
d_cochrane_institute_desc: Named after Zefram Cochrane, this institution is dedicated to technological research and development, including warp propulsion, starship design and transporter technology.
d_columns_ineti_desc: Located on the continent of Bastal in the equatorial region of the planet, the Columns of Ineti are an ancient landmark of the Centauran civilisation from the nearby planet Al Rijil.
d_coppelius_station_desc: A luxurious facility where organic life began anew.
d_coridan_newcoridan_desc: Built upon the wealth of the vast mineral deposits upon Coridan, New Coridan is the central trading point for all vessels passing through the system.
d_cravica_ruins_desc: The ruins of the capital of the Cravic people lies here, still irradiated after the Automated Personnel Units turned against their creators. Functioning machinery still produces limited amounts of Chromodynamic Power Modules for use in the creation process of the machines.
d_delos_felicium_desc: A flower with extreme pharmaceutical properties, but with a powerful narcotic effect.
d_denobula_kaybin_desc: The Kaybin District is a large city district known for its nightclubs, sometimes called 'Kaybin bars', where, during the Denobulan mating season, one could find intimate companions.
d_dosi_emporium_desc: Many spices from numerous worlds are sold within the grand emporium on Dosi. The trade may seem small at first glance, but entire continents worth of trade pass through here every single day.
d_dosi_rexlar_desc: A vast trading hub where the volatile Dosi can undertake business - and ensure all deals are done to their satisfaction.
d_earth_armstrong_city_desc: Armstrong City is situated on the banks of Lake Armstrong, a man-made body of water within a nearby crater.
d_earth_atlantic_ridge_desc:
The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is a mountain range in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean on Earth, formed where the tectonic plates of Eurasia and North America meet. 

Proposals to terraform a new subcontinent rising out of the mountainous terrain have been proposed, but would be costly.
d_earth_atlantis_desc: The Atlantis Project is a small subcontinent formed out of the aquatic, mountainous Mid-Atlantic ridge. Massive harmonic resonators are used to relieve the tectonic pressures, whilst allowing the mantle to reform into habitable terrain.
d_earth_cambridge_desc: Home to Cambridge University, which was founded in approximately 1209 and is one of the oldest, most prestigious universities on Earth.
d_earth_daystrom_desc: Based in Okinawa, Japan, the institute is considered the primary location in the Federation for advanced research, with the top minds in Starfleet and the Civilian sector working on a vast array of projects.
d_earth_millenium_gate_desc:
The Millennium Gate is a 21st century structure and Earth's first self-sustaining civic environment. Built in Portage Creek in the early part of the 21st century, its construction was finished around the year 2012. 

The Millennium Gate is one kilometre high, has a base width of 3.2 kilometres, and can be seen from space. The Gate itself is covered in highly reflective solar panels and was built as a self-contained biosphere with its own ecosystem. 

The Millennium Gate served as a model for the first colony on Mars.
d_earth_mojave_desc: Historically a desert region, centuries of irrigation projects and weather adjustments have turned the Mojave desert into a veritable green parkland. Farms now flourish all throughout the area.
d_earth_nuclear_wasteland_rio_desc: Devastated in World War III, the remains of Rio de Janeiro are littered with broken shanties and favelas. Vast amounts of rebuilding is still to be done a century after the devastation, with millions of tons of irradiated water requiring treatment and replacement.
d_earth_nuclear_wasteland_shanghai_desc: Hit by multiple nuclear devices during World War III, the land surrounding Shanghai is a desolate wasteland where crops are unable to grow even after a century of rebuilding. A large investment is required to reclaim this land and replenish the soil.
d_earth_orpheus_desc: Orpheus Mining Colony is a mobile mining structure capable of launching itself off the surface of the moon and landing in a new area.
d_earth_paris_desc: Paris has a long and distinguished history in Earth culture. In 2130, the Place de la Concorde in Paris was the site for the signing of the Traité d'Unification, the treaty that established United Earth's existence.
d_earth_san_francisco_desc: A large city on the North American continent, San Francisco is the capital of United Earth.
d_earth_tycho_city_desc: Tycho City is one of several lunar landmarks which are large enough to be seen from Earth during the daytime.
d_earth_ural_mountains_desc: The Ural Mountains are a mountain range that run approximately from north to south through western Russia, from the coast of the Arctic Ocean to the Ural River and northwestern Kazakhstan. They are known for their wolves.
d_earth_vineyards_desc: The vineyards of Burgundy are renowned for their soils and grape-growing fertility. For centuries this land has produced the finest wines on the planet, and some Starfleet officers say they wish to retire here to start their own vineyard.
d_earth_yosemite_desc: Yosemite National Park is an area located on the North American continent on Earth. The park is well-known for its scenic beauty.
d_edosian_suckerfish_desc: The Edosian suckerfish is a water-dwelling creature native to the Edosian homeworld. The fish resembles the catfish of Earth and is valued by doctors, for its alleged medicinal purposes.
d_efros_ice_fields_desc: The frozen ice fields of Efros are a wonder to see, but deadly to anyone unprepared.
d_ekos_ekosis_desc: Ekosis is the largest city on the planet Ekos. It is the traditional capital city of the ancient kingdom Thalossis, and is located at the east coast of the planet's large supercontinent, adjacent to the Tharossen Ocean.
d_ferenginar_bowog_bog_desc: Bowog Bog is a swampy region on the planet Ferenginar, near the settlement of Upper Bowog Bay.
d_ferenginar_caverns_of_sogg_desc: The Caverns of Sogg are a series of caves on the planet Ferenginar. It is the location of the oldest known writing on the planet, consisting of three early hieroglyphic symbols: 'female', 'profit', and 'male'. Most notable about the image is that all the males are dead, and the female has the money.
d_ferenginar_flunkatraz_desc: Flunkatraz is a large island that has historically been used as a prison on Ferenginar.
d_ferenginar_gleb_jungle_desc: The Gleb Jungle is a location on the planet Ferenginar. It remains undeveloped, despite several attempts to build on the marshland, all of which failed. This left the jungle untouched and overgrown, even now.
d_ferenginar_gothis_mountains_desc: Historic castles and fortresses are often found deep within the Gothis Mountains, remnants of a time long ago where the wealthy would store their goods in vast vaults.
d_ferenginar_isle_of_grub_desc: The Isle of Grub is an island on the planet Ferenginar that is infamous as the location of the Isle of Grub Festival. Following the cancellation of a performance by a music group at the festival, rioters injured a hundred thousand fans, and every structure on the isle was burned to the ground. Grub worms are now commonly found here.
